degree_rationale: Seven works of the Living Spirit in cosmos formation — bringing up First Man, spreading the clothed one, structuring the death-substances, establishing ships of light, sending the five sons, setting up the Zone, the Ambassador's projection. Executive-essence works.

grand_man_function: Celestial executive sevenfold — the inmost works completed by the Spirit.
title: Seven works the Living Spirit performed in the formation of the cosmos
